name: Travato
notes: Re-verified October 16, 2026 against Winnebago's Travato product page and the 2026 Travato brochure. Winnebago's product page still exposes no usable price (rendered Price: 0 USD), so the starting price remains the best verified dealer base (Lichtsinn), spanning roughly $183,783 to a $216,037 manufacturer window-sticker base (59KL) across floorplans. The brochure weights-and-measurements table publishes columns for the 59G, 59K and 59KL; the 59GL shares the 59G layout. No Travato-specific warranty figure was verified from a manufacturer source in this pass, so no warranty figure is published.
